name: $100 Allocation Test
deliverable: Capital-constrained prioritization surfacing true value trade-offs

steps.text: Give each person one hundred dollars to spend.
Require whole dollars so every choice costs another.
Invest silently and independently, then hand in sheets.
Total the sheets and mark consensus and solo bets.
Discuss the outliers and the shared zeros.

failure: Peanut-buttering: the budget splits evenly across every item, so no trade-off is made and nothing is ranked.
intervention: Reject a flat allocation and require one zero plus forty dollars on a single item; ask what that choice reveals.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in participatory budgeting; no single documented originator.
